#### Supporting Information  

This site overviews and provides demonstrative analyses for the manuscript:   

### Spatial Dynamics of New World Screwworm Invasion: Density Dependence, Stratified Dispersal, and Surveillance-Corrected Inference. (in review)         
  
:::
